data.name: Super-Raft Snorkel - AM
data.headline: Speedboat Snorkel • 4 hours • Adventure and Comfort
data.description: Join us on the Kona Explorer, a 41 ft. Super-Raft, for a thrilling 4-hour morning snorkel adventure. Visit two of Kona's most underrated snorkeling sites, where in-water guides will enhance your experience. All snorkeling gear, including prescription masks (with advance notice), is provided, along with a picnic lunch and refreshments. Enjoy the swift and exciting ride on a raft equipped with plenty of seating, shade, and a bathroom.

highlight_box.title: Not like other inflatable rafts.
highlight_box.description: This raft is nimble. We can dart toward whatever catches the eye of the group and still frequent our favorite snorkel sites. But what people talk about upon leaving are the luxury and comfort.

data.cancellation_summary: Full refund with appropriate notice based on group size; no refund for late arrivals
data.cancellation_notes: To receive a full refund, cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance for parties of 9 or fewer, 72 hours for parties of 10–19, and 7 days for parties of 20 or more. Full refunds are provided only in the event of an operator cancellation. Please note that refunds are not available for late arrivals or motion sickness, as sea conditions and individual reactions are beyond our control.
data.booking_notes:
#Mahalo for booking with Body Glove Cruises

We look forward to welcoming you for your Super-Raft Snorkel Tour!

Free parking is available at our retail shop in Ilima Court Shopping Center. The address is 75-5629 Kuakini Highway, Kailua Kona, HI 96740. It's about a 5-7 minute walk down to the pier. Boarding begins 30 minutes prior to departure.

##Discover unique, locally made treasures in our gift shop [The Boatique](https://www.instagram.com/theboatiquehi/)—show this email for 10% off your purchase!

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/cGKvVAYQeO8QiavAeq1K)

***
#Boat Information:

- This tour takes place on the [Kona Explorer](https://www.bodyglovehawaii.com/our-boat), our 41 ft. Super Raft.
- Please note that our vessel is a **SMOKE FREE** vessel.
- Our boat requires you to be physically agile and able to navigate the boarding process with ease, this is to ensure the safety of all passengers and crew on board.
- If you have concerns about your ability to board the boat, we encourage you to speak with one of our crew members who will be happy to assist you in finding the best solution.

***
#Included On This Trip:

- All your snorkeling gear
- Picnic lunch
- Reef safe sunscreen
- Soft drinks & snacks
- Prescription snorkel masks from -1.5 to -7.0 are available with 24 hour advance notice.
 Please have prescription strength available when requesting.

**Please Bring:**
Towel
***
#Special Dietary Requests:
For gluten-free, vegetarian, or vegan meals, please call 800.551.8911 at least **48 hours** before your adventure.

##Due to extreme exposure to Fun & Excitement, we unfortunately cannot welcome children five years and younger, or pregnant women on this tour.##
